trace.question: Please list the Italian names of the cards in the set Coldsnap with the highest converted mana cost.
trace.evidence: card set Coldsnap refers to name = 'Coldsnap'; Italian refers to language = 'Italian'; highest converted mana cost refers to MAX(convertedManaCost)

attempts.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT fd.name
FROM foreign_data fd
JOIN cards c ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE fd.language = 'Italian'
  AND c.setCode = (SELECT code FROM sets WHERE name = 'Coldsnap')
  AND c.convertedManaCost = (
      SELECT MAX(c2.convertedManaCost)
      FROM cards c2
      WHERE c2.setCode = (SELECT code FROM sets WHERE name = 'Coldsnap')
  )

trace.final_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT fd.name
FROM foreign_data fd
JOIN cards c ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE fd.language = 'Italian'
  AND c.setCode = (SELECT code FROM sets WHERE name = 'Coldsnap')
  AND c.convertedManaCost = (
      SELECT MAX(c2.convertedManaCost)
      FROM cards c2
      WHERE c2.setCode = (SELECT code FROM sets WHERE name = 'Coldsnap')
  )
trace.answer: The Italian names of the Coldsnap cards with the highest converted mana cost are: Devastazione Solare, Requisire, Jokulmorder, Gufo Gelopiuma, Araldo di Leshrac, Inchioda Anima, Cavalcacieli di Tresserhorn, Furia dell'Orda, Drago Geloscaglia, Cavalca Allosauro, Wurm Panglaciale, and Garza Zol, Regina della Peste.
